overview:
tools/mforce_ui/main.cpp is a single 14,658-line translation unit holding the entire ImGui/imnodes patch-editor application: data model, JSON load/save, audio engine bridge, every panel, and main(). It is organized top-down by banner comments (`// ====`): (1) the editor model — Pin, GraphNode (which owns its mforce ValueSource via create_dsp/build_pins), Link, NodeGroup — and the flat global graph (s_nodes/s_links/s_groups) plus document-level stash globals (passthrough paramMap/score/seconds JSON, conversion stash, dirty/close flags); (2) file I/O — Win32 dialogs, legacy paramMap->wiring conversion, an 800-line load_graph_from_path, recents/settings persistence, serialize_patch_graph and the node-graph saver; (3) the audio bridge — RtAudio globals, a 16-slot Voice pool, continuous stream channels, buffer playback, generate_unified (offline render that fills the waveform buffers and per-node strips), and the live path (cached InstrumentPatch, held-note/legato, play_continuous); (4) UI panels in roughly the order they were added — Keyboard/MIDI, Audition, Shape editor, paramMap curves + CurveNode editor, Parameter-mapping dialog, Transport, node/group rendering, Properties, clipboard, graph-mode conversion, context menus, waveform/spectrum/strip drawing; (5) crash logging and a 1,711-line main() that first dispatches ~11 headless CLI modes (--roundtrip-style load/save, gating walk, generate check, rename/replace/paste/convert/dump-playback/dump-layout/dump-stream) and then runs the GLFW/ImGui frame loop containing the menu bar, the Node Editor window (breadcrumb, drill camera, link projection through collapsed groups and wormholes, selection, shortcuts), the panel draw calls, and the save-prompt modal.

Threading: the UI thread owns the graph and all s_/g_ state. RtAudio runs audio_callback (3857) on its own thread; it reads g_voices, g_streamSource/g_streamChannels and g_bufferPlayback, and the UI thread serializes mutation of those (and graph rewiring in update_node_dsp/dsp_rewire_link) through g_audioMutex (933). Meters, heartbeat and restart requests cross threads via std::atomic (3653-3667); audio_watchdog (4084) and voice_gc (4151) run on the UI thread each frame, voice_gc existing so DSP shared_ptrs are released off the audio thread. RtMidi is polled on the UI thread (pump_midi, 5080). Headless modes set s_headless (721) and never create a GL window or audio stream. Forward declarations are scattered rather than grouped (transport_set_status is declared at 1392, 4077 and 4279 before its definition at 8295; stop_streams/stop_playback/buffer_playback_detach at 1111-1191; note_played at 4595; collect_envelopes at 4596; paste_clipboard at 10942). Note for the section-11 reviewer: the banner at 3541-3545 still describes the retired waveOut polling design; the code below it is the RtAudio callback design described at 3642-3646.
